docs/DESIGN-NOTES.md: new F (fix-pass deliberate deviations: headlights, ending smoke and fire light, 1.1 s flashlight, deterministic extra step, quick vent stop, unlock-only interaction, mug moved, seated pitch 0.03); D now points to E6.

left: Owner play-test (spec §9.5): play with defaults and with ?pace=0, then decide the five E6 questions in DESIGN-NOTES (lock gate, the 02:11→02:05 retime, sub-poses, act length, the 01:58:41 stamp and the ▲ CAM-0n line).
Ending with reduceFlicker was only measured to about 30 s after unlock. Under machine load the run hit its 240 s real-time cap before the return-to-desk beat.
The CAM-03 trail is mostly hidden by the figure's own body at index 4; it reads clearly only at index 5–6. Widening or offsetting it would need its own pass.
The flashlight turn-on from a near-black emergency room measures 82% per 0.25 s with the 0.004 floor (24% against the local level). That is the systems fixer's 1.1 s ramp and was not changed here.
vmdTone is −30.8 dBFS isolated but peaks at −27.0 to −29.0 dBFS in context with the ambience. If a strict ≤ −28 dBFS mix is wanted, lower SFX_GAIN.vmdTone from 0.5 to about 0.42.

The CAM-03 OSD tag stays latched for the whole visit, per spec. A player who never switches away keeps seeing an older stamp (for example 02:02:31 at 02:03:59), because CAM-03 alarms are cancelled during calls.
Draw calls and the frame-time hitch were not measured on real hardware. SwiftShader at load average 7 is too noisy (baseline 786 ms per frame); the program-count check stands in for the hitch test.
Not pushed or deployed from here; the background autosave job handles merging. index.html is not tracked on this branch: only a plain `node scripts/build.mjs` writes it for GitHub Pages.
